exposure: average or higher monthly household income
cohort: Mothers and their facility-born neonates from 12 clinical sites across Bangladesh, Ethiopia, India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Rwanda, and South Africa were recruited.
finding: The study found high incidences of clinically suspected (166.0 per 1000 livebirths) and laboratory-confirmed sepsis (46.9 per 1000 livebirths) and substantial all-cause mortality (0.83 per 1000 neonate-days) in neonates from LMICs, identifying several maternal and neonatal factors associated with these outcomes.
